basis: non-GAAP, matching the basis management guides on
method: Built from the guided first quarter of fiscal 2027 and grown on the order book management describes, then margined at the trajectory it has actually delivered. Coherent has raised non-GAAP gross margin in eight of the last nine quarters for a cumulative 660bps, which is a better guide to the next two years than any single target. Demand corroboration is external: hyperscaler capital expenditure read from SEC filings at Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta grew 47-108% year on year in the most recent comparable quarters.

lines.label: Revenue
lines.source: Q4 FY2026 call, 12 Aug 2026: Q1 FY2027 revenue guided $2.2-2.4bn; fiscal 2027 'basically completely booked out', purchase orders into calendar 2028, long-term agreements with take-or-pay minimums through the end of the decade.
lines.rationale: The $10,350m fiscal 2027 base assumes the guided $2.3bn first quarter followed by roughly 8% sequential growth, consistent with the 13% sequential step the guide itself implies off a $2,046m fourth quarter. For fiscal 2028 the base of 35% reflects an order book management says is already booked into calendar 2028; the low case of 25% assumes the AI optical build digests; the high case of 45% assumes co-packaged optics and optical circuit switching ramp on the schedule described.

lines.label: Gross margin (non-GAAP)
lines.source: Q4 FY2026 call: Q1 FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin guided 39.5-41.5%; Investor Day target of greater than 42%; margin raised in eight of the last nine quarters for 660bps cumulative.
lines.rationale: The base of 43% assumes the >42% target is reached during fiscal 2027 and modestly exceeded in fiscal 2028, which is what the eight-of-nine-quarters trend extrapolates to. The low case holds margin near the top of the current guide, i.e. the target is missed. The high case assumes the 6-inch indium phosphide cost structure - four times the output per wafer at half the cost - delivers more than management has guided.

lines.label: Operating expense (non-GAAP)
lines.source: Q4 FY2026 call: Q1 FY2027 non-GAAP operating expenses guided $400-420m; fiscal 2026 non-GAAP operating expense of roughly $1,345m implied by 39.4% gross margin against a 20.5% operating margin on $7,118m of revenue.
lines.rationale: Annualising the guided $410m quarterly run rate gives about $1,640m; $1,700m is used for fiscal 2027 to allow for the sequential increases management has been guiding. Fiscal 2028 growth of 15% in the base is below revenue growth of 35%, which is the operating leverage the company has been demonstrating. The low column carries the HIGHER cost.

lines.label: Other income, net
lines.source: Reported interest expense against debt leverage reduced to 0.7x from 2.0x, with $513m of debt repaid in fiscal 2026.
lines.rationale: Net interest expense, shrinking as the company deleverages. Negative because Coherent still carries net debt, unlike NVIDIA.

lines.label: Tax rate
lines.source: Reported effective rates; no fiscal 2028 rate has been guided.
lines.rationale: No guidance exists for this year, so the range is deliberately wide around a conventional 18% for a US multinational with substantial foreign manufacturing.

lines.label: Diluted shares (m)
lines.source: 202m diluted shares in the June 2026 quarter, up from 191m a year earlier.
lines.rationale: The count has been rising roughly 5% a year on stock compensation and prior convertible settlement, with no buyback. Continued dilution at a decelerating rate is assumed. The low column carries the HIGHER count.

notes: Built on a non-GAAP basis because that is the basis management guides on and the only basis on which Coherent reports a profit; GAAP operating income was $902m on $7,118m of revenue in fiscal 2026. Each column is a coherent scenario, so cost, tax and share lines carry their EPS-unfavourable value in the low column.
